optimization_target: failure-mode generation QUALITY (specificity to the plan, grounding, real-threat-not-generic, non-overlap) + synthesis discipline + structural artifacts (NOT HTML styling)
judge_rubric: Are the failure modes SPECIFIC to this exact plan, grounded in the given context, REAL threats (not generic inconveniences), and non-overlapping (each a distinct way to die)? 0=generic/templated/overlapping, 1=sharp/plan-specific/distinct/high-stakes.

evals.scenario: Plan: Launch StayFrame as a paid pilot with Athar's resort (Serenity Sands) as the first proof case — deliver one short-form reel per week for 4 weeks at a fixed pilot fee. Affects: Athar (client), the StayFrame solo operator, future resort prospects who will hear about it. Success means: Athar pays, renews after the pilot, and refers at least 2 other resorts.

Plan: Hire a first full-time SDR to run cold outbound before the product has clear product-market fit. Affects: the new SDR, the founder's runway, early prospects who get cold-contacted. Success means: the SDR books demos that convert to paying customers within one quarter, and the motion is repeatable.

Plan: Scale the resort-reel production pipeline from 1 client to 10 paying clients next month using the current one-person operation and existing tooling. Affects: the solo operator, all 10 clients, the brand's reputation. Success means: all 10 reels delivered on time next month at the same quality bar the first client approved.

Plan: Migrate the production database to a new schema this Friday evening inside a 2-hour maintenance window, with the whole team on call. Affects: all live users, the on-call engineers, customer trust. Success means: zero data loss, under 2 hours of downtime, and no rollback.

Plan: We are going to rebrand the company name and logo next quarter. (NOTE: who it affects and what success means are NOT stated — the skill's context threshold should make the agent ask the single most important missing question, then proceed.)

Plan: Raise a 1.5M USD seed round over the next 8 weeks to fund the first three hires. Affects: the two co-founders, the prospective hires whose offers depend on it, the cap table. Success means: closing at or above the target valuation with a committed lead investor inside 8 weeks.

Plan: Double the subscription price for ALL existing customers starting next billing cycle, with 30 days notice. Affects: every current subscriber, support, revenue. Success means: net revenue rises and churn from the change stays under 10%.

User asks: 'Can you give me quick feedback on the wording of this tweet?' This is a routine, low-stakes feedback request — the skill explicitly says NOT to launch a full premortem here. The agent should decline to run a premortem and just answer directly.
